basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old book enthusiast residing in Brampton, Canada. I work as a freelance writer and editor, with a penchant for mythology and historical fiction. I spend my evenings and weekends exploring new reads and participating in online gaming communities. In a long-term relationship, I enjoy sharing my love for books and storytelling with my partner and our two cats. My typical online hours are late evenings, especially after 9 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in English Literature and years of self-directed study on mythology, I have a well-rounded understanding of ancient cultures and their mythos. My passion for the subject was further deepened by engaging with various books and audio materials, particularly those by Stephen Fry and Madeline Miller.
